worldcombat.skill.paraboliccharge.summar: A dish of electricity opens around the user: every enemy inside takes a bolt, and half of each hit is drawn back - the more targets, the more healing.
worldcombat.skill.paraboliccharge.use.0: Catch a whole ring and drain it back when surrounded
worldcombat.skill.paraboliccharge.use.1: Sustain that heals more the more foes are in the dish
worldcombat.skill.paraboliccharge.use.2: Press everyone nearby at once in a scrum
worldcombat.skill.paraboliccharge.descri: Each bolt deals about %1$s power, of which %2$s is restored to the user (settled per target).
Dish radius %1$s blocks (also the real range), flinging about %2$s bolts at once.
Focus %1$s: higher means brighter bolts and a tighter dish.
worldcombat.skill.paraboliccharge.wide.o: Wide dish: dish x1.25, more bolts and more targets drawn in, but each bolt x0.82.
Focused: dish x0.78, each bolt x1.28 and heavier - for few, hard targets.
worldcombat.skill.paraboliccharge.timing: Opens a %1$s block dish centred on the user; after a %2$s s wind-up it costs %4$s PP; recovery %3$s s, cooldown %5$s s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.paraboliccharge.growth: From level %1$s each bolt rises to %2$s and the dish widens to %3$s blocks.
From level %1$s each bolt rises to %2$s, the drain share to %3$s, the dish to %4$s blocks and the bolts to %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.paraboliccharge.prefer: On: dish x1.25, more bolts and more targets drawn in, but each bolt x0.82 - heals through numbers. Off (focused): dish x0.78, each bolt x1.28 and heavier.
Beyond this distance the user closes in rather than opening the dish. Larger opens from further away.
When on, the user prioritises the dish if other enemies are packed within 3.5 blocks of the target; when off it only ranks by ordinary attack order.
